sloka: अहम् पुनर्देवकुमाररूप ।मलकृतम् तम् सुतमाव्रजन्तम् ।नन्दामि पश्यन्नपि दर्शनेन ।भवामि दृष्ट्वा च पुनर्युवेव ॥२-१२-१०५॥
transliteration: aham punardevakumārarūpa ।malakṛtam tam sutamāvrajantam ।nandāmi paśyannapi darśanena ।bhavāmi dṛṣṭvā ca punaryuveva ॥2-12-105॥

translations.english: When I see my son, handsome and welladorned like the son of a celestial deity, coming towards me, I rejoice. Even his very sight makes me grow young again.
